candidate: Freeze (a,b)=(16,0) and prove G<=16I for parity-masked point defects when the parity mask reuses the defect's physical variables, then close under disjoint products.
prior_status: Sharp GU was known for unmasked point defects and exact zero-remainder character-core reuse was known only when the character core was physically disjoint from residual factors. Posterior-only payment of general orientation was refuted.
mathematical_delta: Derived the exact translated-heavy-atom upper masses, physical restriction recurrence, and influence for every mask weight. Proved G<=16I uniformly for every same-block parity-masked point defect and arbitrary disjoint products, removing the disjoint character-core hypothesis for this proper class.

gu_implication.proved_pair: a=16,b=0 on the stated restriction-closed class
gu_implication.universal_consequence_if_extended: The same pair for every Boolean f would prove universal GU and H(f)<=34I(f).
gu_implication.status: PROVED only for a proper class; universal extension OPEN

case_extension.previous_class: unmasked point defects, plus character cores on a separate physical block
case_extension.new_class: point defects multiplied by arbitrary parity masks on the identical physical block, plus arbitrary disjoint products and pure characters
removed_hypotheses: physical disjointness between character mask and residual point defect
case_extension.remaining_hypothesis: each nontrivial factor has one terminal pure-character child after a coordinate restriction
case_extension.parameter_dependence: constant 16 is independent of n, mask weight, defect location, sign, factor count and depth

verification.method: exact rational Walsh masses/influences plus deterministic binary logarithms

normalization_and_terminal_terms: The squared Fourier law is normalized: p+(2^n-1)q=1.
Upper masses are computed after spectral translation; inclusion is not assumed translation invariant.
Each physical restriction retains its actual one-half weight.
The inactive child is a pure character with exactly zero U; it is retained before being evaluated.
The active child loses mask weight exactly when the restricted coordinate lies in A.
The r=0 sharp theorem is imported from its original artifact, not claimed as new.
obstruction_controls: No favorable ensemble sign is chosen.
No fixed-sign projection, unsigned coefficient-four bound, or unproved larger-coefficient repair is used.
The positive non-affine collision is only a finite control, not an all-dimensional theorem.
A proper-class GU theorem is not labeled universal GU or full FEI.
remaining_obstacle: Pay the oriented source-influence drift when both physical children remain nonterminal and coherently non-character; the terminal-character drop used here is then unavailable.
next_action: Replace the pure-character inactive child by a second masked defect, derive the exact two-heavy-atom upper-mass kernel, and test whether one source-influence charge plus one terminal oriented reserve gives a dimension-free pair.
